jobs.description_text: We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run. We are seeking an experienced and talented Propulsion Ground Support Equipment Team Leader, to lead the development, commissioning and operation of our engine test benches that we use to test our cryogenic engines and storable thrusters. This is a key leadership role that requires technical expertise in liquid-propellant propulsion systems, a strong track record in managing complex engineering projects, and proven experience in leading and mentoring technical teams. As the GSE Team Leader, you will oversee the design, development and building of propulsion test facility. The primary objective is to develop and maintain robust, high-reliability test bench GSE that meets ambitious program cadences while ensuring absolute safety in hazardous operating environments. We embrace AI-native engineering, using AI not only as the workload we optimize, but also as a tool to accelerate system development, experimentation, debugging, optimization, and adaptation to new models. You’ll own our financial model, bring clarity to the economics of our business, and build the reporting and controls that support sound decisions. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You’ll move between evaluating a major commercial agreement, planning headcount, preparing board materials, and making sure our books and cash forecasts are accurate. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own financial planning: Build and maintain our operating model, budget, and forecasts. Connect hiring and investment decisions to revenue, margins, cash, and runway. - Understand our unit economics: Partner with Engineering and Applied AI to measure the cost of delivering customer workflows, including model usage, infrastructure, deployment, and human review. Identify opportunities to improve margins as we scale. - Shape commercial decisions: Work with GTM and leadership on pricing, contract economics, payment terms, and profitability across customers and use cases. - Build the finance function: Own accounting, close, financial reporting, treasury, tax coordination, and controls, working with external partners and building internal capabilities as needed. - Support the board and investors: Prepare financial materials, communicate performance clearly, and lead financial diligence and planning for future financing. - Make finance work efficiently

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll stay close to customer issues while building the playbooks, tools, and processes that help the team deliver consistently as Pace grows. IN PRACTICE, YOU WILL: - Own customer outcomes: Set the standard for how we support customers after deployment. jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE TEAM The Financial Risk team is responsible for protecting Wealthsimple and its clients from fraud while enabling safe, fast, and scalable money movement. We own the Decision Platform — a real-time rules engine that processes streaming data to make fraud decisions across every major payment rail — as well as the tooling and automations that power fraud investigation workflows, transaction decisioning, account restrictions, and deposit holds. Our systems are the infrastructure layer that payment and money movement teams plug into to move money safely. ABOUT THE ROLE This is a platform PM role with a dual mandate: prevent fraud by building and tuning real-time interventions and decision rules, and enable fraud investigations by building automations and tooling that make our fraud operations team faster and more effective. You'll own a broad surface area — from the streaming decision engine that blocks fraudulent withdrawals in milliseconds, to the case management system that routes alerts to investigators, to the restriction and suspension frameworks that protect compromised accounts. Behind every account transfer is a complex network of institutions, systems, and people — and our job is to make that all feel simple. We power the platform that ensures money moves reliably, efficiently, and transparently for our clients, and we're always growing our product offering so clients can transfer more accounts, in more ways and easier than ever. jobs.title: Estate Planning Specialist, Wealth Management
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE This is the first role of its kind at Wealthsimple. As our Estate Planning Specialist, you'll build the foundation of how we review and optimize estate plans for our Wealth Management clients — an area that many HNW clients fail to properly address, even when the rest of their financial plan is sound. You'll join a growing specialist bench that already includes our Tax Planning team and our Family Enterprise Advisor. Like those functions, your job isn't to draft legal documents or sell products — it's to review clients' existing wills, trust documents, and broader estate plans, identify where they no longer align with (or never accounted for) the client's actual goals, and clearly explain in plain language what needs to change and who can help make that happen. This is not a sales role and will not be selling insurance, or anything else. Your job is to advocate for the client's best interests — identifying gaps and misalignments, and connecting clients to the right resource to solve them, whether that's our estate lawyer referral network, our documentation-drafting partners. As the newest Specialist to the team, you won't just be executing an established process — you'll be responsible for helping design and build the estate review and planning process itself, in partnership with the Wealth Management leadership team.
